statement.zh: 不加前提的规律对每个世界成立，前提划出部分：活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现恰当止息复现，活跨越生起与止息，耗散之下有限世界归于停息不能被否证。
statement.en: Premise-free laws hold of every world and premises carve parts: in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, living crosses arising and ceasing, and under dissipation a finite world cannot be refuted to come to rest.

laws.zh: 一个世界是以一类读法的关系项、其间的流与依存网；空间是每个世界。两类读法的任一流与网都是一个世界，生起与止息在那里读法相同。
laws.en: A world is its relata, read with one kind, with the flow among them and their web; the space is every world. The two-kind reading of any flow and web is a world, and arising and ceasing read the same there.

laws.zh: Becoming.Change 的规律与 Becoming.Evolution 的算术恒等式（Price 方程的计数形式）不加关于展开的前提，对每个网与每个量陈述，所以对整个空间成立。
laws.en: The laws of Becoming.Change and the arithmetic identity of Becoming.Evolution (the counting form of Price's equation) are stated of every web and every amount with no premise about the unfolding, so they hold throughout the space.

laws.zh: 读于部分：生起复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步生起）与止息复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步止息）在有限且活动可判定的世界中恰好同时成立。
laws.en: Read of parts: arising recurring (some relatum arising at arbitrarily late steps) and ceasing recurring (some relatum ceasing at arbitrarily late steps) hold together exactly in every finite world whose activity is decided.

laws.zh: 可判定性是这一规律自己的条件，不是表示的承诺：对每个有限世界都要求这一规律而不给可判定性，它就等价于排中律，在纯净核心中陈述，不需要选择公理。这一需要来自活动是命题（World.undecided 在一步放入任意命题），所以它是已定规律的引理，此外不说变化的任何事。
laws.en: Decidedness is this law's own condition, not a commitment of the representation: asked of every finite world without it, the law is equivalent to excluded middle, stated in the pure core with no choice. The need comes from activity being a proposition (World.undecided sets an arbitrary one at a step), so this is a lemma of the decided law and says nothing further about change.

laws.zh: 关系项无限多时，两者各可以没有另一个而复现（由 Accretion 与 Attrition 给出），这些世界无限由该规律推出。
laws.en: With infinitely many relata either can recur without the other (from Accretion and Attrition), and that these worlds are infinite follows from the law.

laws.zh: 活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、耗散、体现与承载活动的储备，每一个都有满足与不满足它的世界：它们是前提，不是规律。
laws.en: Activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment and a reserve carrying activity are each met by some worlds and not by others: they are premises, not laws.

laws.zh: 有限世界中，生起复现与否，都既可以每个事件都活（逐步读法中不侵蚀），也可以有事件不活；活动可判定时，止息复现与否也是如此；所以生起与止息都不决定事件是否活。
laws.en: Among finite worlds, arising recurring or not occurs both with every event living, not undermining in the stepwise reading, and with some event not living, and with activity decided so does ceasing recurring or not; so neither arising nor ceasing decides whether events are living.

laws.zh: 其见证：两侧来回传递一个水平（shuttle），同样的两侧另有一个吃草者把另一个关系项所依存的池汲低（grazing），始终活跃的互利者（mutualism），以及把池汲低的亲代（drawdown）。
laws.en: Its witnesses: two sides handing one standing back and forth (shuttle), the same sides with a grazer drawing down a pool another relatum depends on (grazing), mutualists active throughout (mutualism), and a parent drawing a pool down (drawdown).

laws.zh: grazing 的不活在对终结之步汲取承担自身者的判定之外，但被侵蚀的食草者在该步之后不活跃。
laws.en: grazing's verdict lies outside the verdict about drawing on a self-bearing relatum at its own ending, but the browser it undermines is not active after that step.

laws.zh: 活动需要支持时，跨一步落到所需之下、以不低的所需持续的依存，属于在步后不活跃的形成；依存者原本活跃时，这是它的终结；依存者休眠时没有任何终结：在 seedbank 中一个事件不活，而世界中从无止息。
laws.en: Where activity needs support, a dependence left below its need and persisting at no lower need belongs to a formation not active after the step; where that formation was active this is its ending, and where it was dormant nothing ends: in seedbank an event is not living while nothing in the world ever ceases.

laws.zh: 同样的活动而每侧汲取自身的水平（selfDrawing）也有不活的事件，但只在逐步读法对体现关系项终结之步自我汲取的判定之下；这一判定是逐步读法的定理，比较不用它。
laws.en: The same activity while each side draws on its own standing (selfDrawing) also has an event that is not living, but only on the stepwise reading's verdict about drawing on a self-bearing embodied relatum at its ending, a theorem of that reading which no comparison uses.

laws.zh: 在有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界中，世界从某步起停息不能被否证，所以生起与止息都不复现，不用判定程序；两半在共同的一步合起。
laws.en: In a finite, balanced, dissipative world in which whatever arises is embodied, that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted, so neither arising nor ceasing recurs, with no decision procedure; the two halves join at a common step.

laws.zh: 每个前提都不可少：燃烧新燃料的世界以无限多关系项继续生起（throughput）；两侧来回传递，在没有耗散时继续生起（shuttle）；持有者每步取用自身一个单位而不给予，在没有平衡时继续生起，而它的耗散不空，两侧的家族每步封闭并被取用（leaking）。
laws.en: Each premise of rest is needed: a world burning fresh fuel keeps arising with infinitely many relata (throughput); two sides handing a standing keep arising without dissipation (shuttle); the holder taking its own unit and giving nothing keeps arising without balance, with non-vacuous dissipation, the family of both sides closed and taken from at every step (leaking).

laws.zh: 活动不是其水平的关系项在没有体现时继续生起（flicker），它从某步起不参与交换：有限、平衡且耗散的世界中取用不复现，所以任何这样的见证都如此。
laws.en: A relatum whose activity is not its standing keeps arising without embodiment (flicker), taking part in no exchange from some step on, as any such witness must, since taking does not recur in a finite, balanced, dissipative world.

laws.zh: 本结果陈述活动的读法，生起复现与止息复现，二者在有限世界中重合；作为关系，更新的形成与消耗的形成不重叠。
laws.en: This result states the reading of activity, arising recurring and ceasing recurring, which coincide in finite worlds; read as relations, renewing and consuming formations do not overlap.

laws.zh: 停息不用判定程序。从某步起不上升的量，其下降从某步起停止不能被否证：并非此后每一步之后再有下降都不能被否证；两种写法等价；它此后不变不能被否证。
laws.en: Rest needs no decision procedure. For an amount that does not rise from some step on, that its falls stop from some step on cannot be refuted: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later fall stays unrefuted; the two forms are equivalent, and that it stays the same from some step on cannot be refuted.

laws.zh: 从某步起被平衡与耗散的家族中，体现的成员的生起从某步起停止不能被否证：并非此后每一步之后其中再有生起都不能被否证。
laws.en: In a family balanced and dissipated on from some step on, that the arising of the embodied members stops from some step on cannot be refuted: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later arising of one of them stays unrefuted.

laws.zh: 有一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者时，止息复现使此后每一步之后的生起都不能被否证（经 laws-of-one-step 的覆盖定律），这一不能被否证的停止否证它；所以 World.rests_unrefuted_covering 与 World.rests_unrefuted 不要求活动可判定，陈述更强。
laws.en: With a list covering what is active from some step on, ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step (through the covering law of laws-of-one-step), which the unrefuted stopping refutes; so World.rests_unrefuted_covering and World.rests_unrefuted need no decided activity, their statements stronger.

laws.zh: 规律与停息对每个世界有局部形式：一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者（不要世界有限）；停息另要该家族从某步起平衡与耗散，不要闭合、不要别的家族或步；World.arising_iff_ceasing、World.rests_unrefuted 是它们的推论。
laws.en: The law and rest hold of every world in a local form: one list covering the active relata from some step on (no finiteness of the world), rest also asking the family to be balanced and dissipated on from that step, with no closure and no premise on other families or steps; World.arising_iff_ceasing and World.rests_unrefuted are their corollaries.

laws.zh: 依存落到所需之下对每个世界有局部形式，只用该形成在步后活跃时被支持；Web.Dependent.inactive_below、Web.Dependent.ceases_below 是它的推论。
laws.en: Leaving a dependence below its need holds of every world in a local form, using only that the formation is supported after the step where it is active then; Web.Dependent.inactive_below and Web.Dependent.ceases_below are its corollaries.

hypotheses.zh: 规律（arising_iff_ceasing）：世界有限，即有一个不重复地列出全部关系项的列表；每步每个关系项是否活跃是可判定的。可判定性是这一规律自己的条件，不是表示的承诺，经典地总是成立；对每个有限世界都要求这一规律而不给它，它就等价于排中律（law_iff_em）。
hypotheses.en: The law (arising_iff_ceasing): the world is finite, a list naming every relatum once; whether each relatum is active at each step is decidable. Decidedness is this law's own condition, not a commitment of the representation, classically always met; asked of every finite world without it, the law is equivalent to excluded middle (law_iff_em).

hypotheses.zh: 停息（rests）：另加平衡（Balanced）、耗散（Dissipative）与生起者体现（ArisingEmbodied）；不要求活动可判定（P58）。
hypotheses.en: Rest (rests): also balance (Balanced), dissipation (Dissipative) and whatever arises being embodied (ArisingEmbodied); activity need not be decided (P58).

hypotheses.zh: 其余都是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提；law_decides 以那一规律对每个有限世界成立为假设。
hypotheses.en: The rest are statements about particular worlds, with no premise; law_decides takes the law for every finite world as its hypothesis.

hypotheses.zh: law_of_em 以排中律为假设（定理的假设，不是公理），不要求可判定性。
hypotheses.en: law_of_em takes excluded middle as a hypothesis (of the theorem, not an axiom) and needs no decidability.

does_not_show.zh: 本结果不证明整个生成之论不需要公理：它显示哪些陈述不需要前提、哪些前提划出哪些部分。
does_not_show.en: The result does not prove that the theory of becoming needs no axiom: it shows which statements need no premise and which premises carve which parts.

does_not_show.zh: Living 只是逐步读法的结构条件，不是生生之意义的估值本身。
does_not_show.en: Living is only the structural condition of the stepwise reading, not the valuation of living significance itself.

does_not_show.zh: 部分的列举不完全：前提的组合与更多的部分（例如更多、可能性的上升）没有逐一给出。
does_not_show.en: The parts listed are not exhaustive: combinations of premises and further parts, such as more or the rise of possibility, are not each given.

does_not_show.zh: 本结果只陈述活动的读法；Ren 的“生成的”“退化的”读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，那是另一种读法，不是这一读法。
does_not_show.en: This result states only the reading of activity; Ren's ‘generative’ and ‘degenerative’ are read as widening and narrowing what can form, a reading other than this one.

does_not_show.zh: 与依存者在该步之后不活跃同时的侵蚀，在逐步读法下对每个汲取者都计入不活，这一判定不是对汲取者的估值。
does_not_show.en: Undermining that co-occurs with the depending relatum not being active after the step counts against living on the stepwise reading, for every drawer, a verdict that is no valuation of the drawer.

detail.zh: 无限多关系项时生起与止息分离（Accretion、Attrition）；rests 的每个前提缺少时生起可以复现（throughput、shuttle、leaking、flicker），leaking 的耗散不空；grazing 不依赖自我汲取的判定而有不活的事件；undecided 显示有限世界的规律需要可判定性。
detail.en: With infinitely many relata arising and ceasing separate (Accretion, Attrition); without any one premise of rests arising can recur (throughput, shuttle, leaking, flicker), leaking with non-vacuous dissipation; grazing has an event that is not living without the verdict on self-drawing; undecided shows that the finite-world law needs decidability.

detail.zh: seedbank：有限、平衡、每个关系项体现、活动需要支持；汲取者的事件侵蚀休眠种子持续不变的依存，事件不活，inactive_below 的前提成立，而种子从不活跃，世界中从无止息：侵蚀不必与终结同时。
detail.en: seedbank: finite, balanced, every relatum embodied, activity needing support; the drawer's event undermines a dormant seed's unchanged dependence and is not living, and the premises of inactive_below hold, yet the seed is never active and nothing in the world ever ceases: undermining need not co-occur with an ending.

next_delta.zh: 更多的部分（更多、可能性与多样性的上升）与前提组合的地图；不可判定活动时有限世界的规律已在纯净核心中以排中律为假设陈述（law_of_em）。
next_delta.en: A map of further parts (more, the rise of possibility and diversity) and of combinations of premises; the law for finite worlds without decidable activity is stated in the pure core with excluded middle as a hypothesis (law_of_em).

correspondence.zh: Ren 的原话（2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority）：“when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0”。计划 P22 把这读作：规律对整个空间成立，前提划出部分。作者的读法（AI 论证）：本结果给出这一提议的一种结构。整体是每个世界；不加关于展开的前提的规律（变化的规律、算术恒等式，以及活动可判定的有限世界中生起与止息的同时复现）对整体成立；各定理的前提每一个都划出真部分，不是隐藏的规律。Ren 在 2026-10-09 说：“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”（2026-10-09-renewing-consuming-without-axioms）。所以本结果不把生起复现与止息复现称为生成的与退化的部分：二者在有限世界中重合；作为关系，更新的形成与消耗的形成不重叠（Web.renewing_not_consuming），同一事件可以参与二者。依 Ren 的交托，提议中的“生成的、退化的”读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，在形成的层次上是更新与消耗，不取活动的读法（第九次独立审查 M1；DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）。Ren 说加上公理可以定义好，“好”是整个空间的一部分；这里的 Living 是逐步读法中“每个事件都活”的结构条件，是 G0 所计的 living 的一个部分，它跨越生起与止息，不与其中任何一个重合：生起不是活的同义词，止息也不是不活。这不证明整个生成之论不需要任何公理：它显示哪些陈述不需要前提、哪些前提划出哪些部分；“不加实质公理的整体演绎必然性”仍是开放的首要目标。“世界”“生起复现”“止息复现”是 AI 的表述，按 Ren 的命名规则采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D36）。英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）。
correspondence.en: Ren's words (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority): ‘when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0’. Plan P22 reads this as: the laws hold of the whole space, and premises carve parts. The author's reading (an AI argument): this result gives one structure for that proposal. The whole is every world; the laws with no premise about the unfolding (the laws of change, the arithmetic identity, and arising and ceasing recurring together in finite worlds whose activity is decided) hold of the whole; each premise of the theorems carves a proper part and is not a hidden law. On 9 October Ren said: ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’ (2026-10-09-renewing-consuming-without-axioms). So this result does not call arising recurring and ceasing recurring the generative and degenerative parts: they coincide in finite worlds, while read as relations renewing and consuming formations do not overlap (Web.renewing_not_consuming), though one event can take part in both. On Ren's delegation the proposal's ‘generative, degenerative’ reads as widening and narrowing what can form, renewing and consuming at the level of formations, not as the activity reading (ninth independent review, M1; DELEGATED-CHOICES D2). Ren says that with an axiom we can define the good as a part of the whole space; Living here is the structural condition that every event is living in the stepwise reading, one part of what G0 counts as living, and it crosses arising and ceasing without coinciding with either: arising is not a synonym for living, and ceasing is not not-living. This does not prove that the theory of becoming needs no axiom at all: it shows which statements need no premise and which premises carve which parts; the deductive necessity of the whole without added substantive axioms remains the open first priority. ‘World’, ‘arising recurring’ and ‘ceasing recurring’ are the AI's formulations, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36). Ren confirmed the English names arising and ceasing (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names).

detail.zh: 复用止息（Ceases）、形成有限多时生起不息恰当止息不息（unceasing_iff）与 Accretion、Attrition。
detail.en: Reuses ceasing (Ceases), that with finitely many formations arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is (unceasing_iff), and Accretion and Attrition.

output.zh: 形成有限多且活动可判定时，生起不息恰当止息不息；Accretion 与 Attrition 各只有一方。
output.en: With finitely many formations and activity decided, arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is; Accretion and Attrition each have only one.

input.zh: 活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现恰当止息复现；无限世界中两者分离，且其无限由此推出。
input.en: In a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; in infinite worlds they separate, and their infinity follows.

detail.zh: 复用 embodiedArising_not_recurring 与 Shuttle、Throughput、Flicker 三个见证。
detail.en: Reuses embodiedArising_not_recurring and the witnesses Shuttle, Throughput and Flicker.

output.zh: 有限的关系项、平衡与耗散之下，体现的关系项不在任意晚的步生起。
output.en: With finitely many relata, under balance and dissipation, embodied relata do not arise at arbitrarily late steps.

input.zh: 有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界归于停息；每个前提都不可少。
input.en: A finite, balanced, dissipative world whose arising is embodied comes to rest; each premise is needed.

conditions.zh: 平衡；耗散；有限；生起者体现。

detail.zh: 复用一类读法（roles 与其迁移引理）、体现与 Mutualism。
detail.en: Reuses the one-kind reading (roles and its transfer lemmas), embodiment and Mutualism.

output.zh: 两类读法嵌入一类读法，生起不息在其中不变；互利者的每个事件都活；Shuttle 的两侧来回传递一个水平。
output.en: The two-kind reading embeds in the one-kind reading, keeping unceasing arising; every event of the mutualists is living; the sides of Shuttle hand one standing back and forth.

input.zh: 每个两类的流与网都是一个世界；有限世界中，生起不复现而每个事件都活；grazing 与 leaking 以 Shuttle 为基础。
input.en: Every two-kind flow and web is a world; a finite world without arising recurring in which every event is living; grazing and leaking build on Shuttle.

detail.zh: 复用储备（Carries）、零储备恰是 Dependent（carries_zero）与 Carries.active_not_recurring。
detail.en: Reuses the reserve (Carries), that Dependent is exactly the zero reserve (carries_zero), and Carries.active_not_recurring.

output.zh: 从某步起不被支持的形成不在任意晚的步活跃。
output.en: A formation unsupported from some step on is not active at arbitrarily late steps.

input.zh: 每步都超出支持而活跃的关系项没有任何储备承载它。
input.en: No reserve carries a relatum active beyond its support at every step.

output.zh: 亲代的取用把池汲低；超出支持的亲代。
output.en: A parent's taking draws a pool down; a parent beyond its support.

input.zh: 有限世界中，生起不复现且有事件不活；活动需要支持的反例。
input.en: A finite world without arising recurring in which some event is not living; a countermodel to activity needing support.

detail.zh: 复用更新与消耗的形成（RenewingIn、ConsumingIn）及二者不重叠（renewing_not_consuming）。
detail.en: Reuses renewing and consuming formations (RenewingIn, ConsumingIn) and that they do not overlap (renewing_not_consuming).

output.en: A renewing formation is not a consuming one.

detail.zh: 完成计划第 9 节下的 P22：规律对整体成立，前提划出部分；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Completes P22 under the plan's section 9: the laws hold of the whole and premises carve parts; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: Living 是逐步读法中每个事件都活（活跃且不侵蚀）的结构条件。
detail.en: Living is the structural condition that every event is living in the stepwise reading, active and not undermining.

detail.zh: 那里一步之内上升与下降的伴随，这里是整个空间中生起与止息的同时复现。
detail.en: There, a rise accompanied by a fall within one step; here, arising and ceasing recurring together across the space.

detail.zh: 有限世界的规律在不要求可判定时的形式：止息永不终止、生起永不终止，以及从某步起已定时的规律。
detail.en: The forms of the law for finite worlds without decidedness: ceasing never stopping for good, arising never stopping for good, and the law where decided from some step on.

history.en: 2026-10-09: added as P22 of the unification plan, following Ren's ‘aim a complete theory of becoming, and finish related work’; see §30 of the integration note.

history.zh: 2026-10-09 P23c：按第九次独立审查（BECOMING-P18B-P23-REVIEW.md）更正，见整合文档 §34。世界的部分改名为生起复现与止息复现（ArisingRecurs、CeasingRecurs，M1），删去“有限世界中生成与退化是同一部分”与“彼此交叠”，记入 Ren 2026-10-09 的原话与关系读法；可判定性列为表示的承诺并新增 law_decides（M2）；新增 grazing（M7）与 leaking（M8）见证。验证范围重新指向合并检查器回执 20261009T132323.308231Z 与外围回执 20261009T132432.792943Z。
history.en: 2026-10-09 P23c: corrected after the ninth independent review (BECOMING-P18B-P23-REVIEW.md); see section 34 of the integration note. The parts of worlds renamed arising recurring and ceasing recurring (ArisingRecurs, CeasingRecurs, M1), with "in a finite world generation and degeneration are one part" and "overlap" removed and Ren's words of 9 October and the relational reading recorded; decidability stated as a commitment of the representation, with law_decides (M2); the witnesses grazing (M7) and leaking (M8) added. Validation scope re-pointed to consolidated receipt 20261009T132323.308231Z and periphery receipt 20261009T132432.792943Z.

history.zh: 2026-10-09 P25b：按第十次独立审查（BECOMING-P23C-P24-P25-REVIEW.md）更正，见整合文档 §38。活跨越止息由 living_crosses_ceasing 检查（grazing 的活动可判定）；grazing 的范围写为在对终结之步汲取承担自身者的判定之外，被侵蚀的食草者在该步终结（grazing_browser_ends、Web.Dependent.inactive_below），这样的侵蚀是否计入不活列为 Ren 的选择（O10）；law_decides 写为蕴含排中律（O11(a)）。验证范围指向合并检查器回执 20261009T145010.627958Z 与外围回执 20261009T161851.010138Z。
history.en: 2026-10-09 P25b: corrected after the tenth independent review (BECOMING-P23C-P24-P25-REVIEW.md); see section 38 of the integration note. Living crossing ceasing is checked by living_crosses_ceasing (grazing's activity decided); grazing's scope is written as outside the verdict about drawing on a self-bearing relatum at its own ending, with the browser it undermines ending at that step (grazing_browser_ends, Web.Dependent.inactive_below), and whether such undermining counts against living is listed as Ren's choice (O10); law_decides is glossed as implying excluded middle (O11(a)). Validation scope points to consolidated receipt 20261009T145010.627958Z and periphery receipt 20261009T161851.010138Z.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P58：陈述更强：World.rests 与 World.rests_covering 去掉活动的判定程序（未用到），名称不变；平息引理（still_le、unrefuted_falls_exceed、falls_settle、amount_settles、Web.generation_settles、World.arising_unrefuted_covering）；可判定性是规律 arising_iff_ceasing 自己的条件，不是表示的承诺（Ren：“i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist”，以“please”接受把它局部化）。见整合文档 §84 与清点页 DECIDABILITY-INVENTORY。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P58: statement strengthened: World.rests and World.rests_covering have the decision procedure on activity dropped (unused); names unchanged; the settling lemmas (still_le, unrefuted_falls_exceed, falls_settle, amount_settles, Web.generation_settles, World.arising_unrefuted_covering); decidedness is the own condition of the law arising_iff_ceasing, not a commitment of the representation (Ren: “i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist”, and “please” to making it local). See §84 of the integration note and the inventory page DECIDABILITY-INVENTORY.

history.en: 2026-10-12 P58b: each name says exactly what its statement says (Ren: “let's adopt these names for now, as long as the proof has the exact meaning”): falls_settle, amount_settles and Web.generation_settles renamed falls_stop_unrefuted, amount_still_unrefuted and Web.generation_stops_unrefuted, statements and proofs unchanged; new stop_unrefuted_iff, by which what the names say is their statement. See §90 of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

Ren's confirmation of the names arising and ceasing moved from the claim to the correspondence, and the round labels of the rest laws (P58, P58c) to history.
